div.div:
Everything that is inside the network should resolve DNS using Adguard.
Adguard holds all my configuration for DNS Rewrites, AD Blockers, ETC
Only disable this for VPN VLan, which access directly Cloudflare DNS to avoid Latency on DNS.

Kubernetes is configured as ClusterFirst resolution. This means that it will first try to resolve within the cluster and only then will try to go outside.
The configuration rely on /etc/resolv.conf file on each node.

On ProxMox, I configured it to point directly to ADGuard IP Address, so all machines that are created within ProxMox will automatically target ADGuard as its primarry address.
On all VLan DHCP config, DNS Server is set to Adguard as well, so all machines should get AdGuard as its primary DNS server.
WAN DNS server is also pointing to AdGuard.
